name: open-points
description: A live view of your project's open points or TODO markdown file: a side pane grouped by status and a one-line count above the prompt.

file.title: List file
file.description: Path to the markdown list, relative to the project or absolute. Empty finds OPEN-POINTS.md or TODO.md by itself.

showBand.title: Show the count above the prompt
showBand.description: One line above the prompt: how many points need you, are being built, and are open.

openPaneOnStart.title: Open the pane when a session starts
openPaneOnStart.description: Opens the side pane at start (it seats from 144 terminal columns).
